subject: Redundant Calculation of mstime() (#2080)
reason: The change only hoists a redundant mstime() call out of a loop in clusterNodeAddFailureReport, storing the same timestamp value computed once instead of calling mstime() at each exit path. Control flow, return values, and failure-report semantics are identical; this is a performance/readability refactor with no observable behaviour change, so there is nothing a scenario could distinguish between the two builds.
